violation_type.title: AP Ensure Total Number of Children Both At and Away From Operation Within Capacity (26 TAC §744.201(11))
violation_type.short_title: AP Ensure Total Number of Children Both At and Away From Operation Within Capacity
violation_type.typical_finding: During inspection, the operation was over capacity by one child for approximately 10 minutes.

finding_variants.text: During inspection, the operation was over capacity by one child for approximately 10 minutes.
At inspection, the operation had 51 children in care, when they are licensed for 49.
It was confirmed that the operation's student attendance has regularly exceeded the operation's permitted capacity.

The operation had 93 children in care at the time of the inspection. The operation had a capacity for 80 children on their permit. This was corrected at inspection when 13 children were picked up from the operation.

During inspection, the operation was found over the capacity allowed on the license/permit. The operation's total capacity is for 40 children. During inspection, there were 60 children in care. Therefore, the operation was over the capacity by 20 children.     This was corrected at inspection after director called parents to pick up some children to lower the total number of children in care to under 40 children. Additional children were picked up by parents before closing time.
There were 75 children in care during my walkthrough of the operation, but the operation's permit only allows for 50 children.
